title: ADA State of Diabetes 2026 Partner
summary: Omada Health's Kevin Masci joins the ADA State of Diabetes panel in Chicago to discuss turning diabetes and obesity guidelines into real-world outcomes.
body_markdown:
# ADA State of Diabetes 2026 Partner


October 19-22, 2025 • Las Vegas, NV


Omada is proud to sponsor the[American Diabetes Association® (ADA) State of Diabetes](https://stateofdiabetes-diabetes.donordrive.com/sodchicago) 2026 annual event in Chicago. This event brings employers, health plan leaders, and local advocates together for important conversations about diabetes, including how it affects people and workplaces, and practical ways to improve health and lower costs.


[Kevin Masci, Pharm D](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kevin-masci-pharm-d-32b81b68/) , Senior Director of Clinical Affairs at Omada, will join a team of expert panelists to discuss this year's theme, "From Diabetes & Obesity Guidelines to Outcomes: Translating Evidence into Real-World Practice." The panel will explore how employers, payers, and community leaders can put the ADA's Standards of Care to work in ways that lead to measurable health improvements and cost savings.


### What we're looking forward to:


- The latest in diabetes care and exploring resources that support healthier lives and access to care


- Practical tools for turning guidelines into benefits, care pathways, and workplace policies


- The chance to connect with employers, health plans and payers, and industry leaders working to improve diabetes outcomes


[Register Now](https://stateofdiabetes-diabetes.donordrive.com/sodchicago)
